title: Affordable Care Act – ACA / Obamacare (Luật Chăm sóc Sức khỏe)

versions.text:
Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA / Obamacare).
Title I: Quality, affordable health care for all Americans. Individual mandate (penalty reduced to $0 in 2019). Health insurance exchanges/marketplaces. Essential health benefits. Pre-existing conditions protections. Dependent coverage to age 26.
Title II: Role of public programs (Medicaid expansion).
Title IX: Revenue provisions. Net investment income tax (3.8%). Additional Medicare tax (0.9%).
